Title: Free Sudoku
FreeIntro: Free Sudoku, without ads or trackers.
HelpIntro: Learn about Sudoku controls and assistance.
HelpNumbers: Select a cell to enter a number or toggle a pencil mark in Notes mode. Tap the selected cell again to deselect it and clear its highlights; select a cell again before entering anything.
HelpNotes: Notes marks candidates instead of filling cells. Selecting a color enables Notes. Leaving painting keeps Notes on. While painting, the first tap on Notes exits painting with Notes on; another tap turns Notes off. The wider Notes button shows its active state. Notes stays set across reloads and game changes.
HelpDrop: Turn on Drop and choose a keypad number; outside Notes and painting, you can also pick a number by tapping a correctly filled cell when enabled in Settings. Highlights follow only the chosen number, without a cell anchor. Tap empty cells to place numbers or toggle notes. Drop and its number survive reloads; game changes keep Drop on/off but clear the number and color. Switching Drop clears cell selection. Completed numbers cannot be placed in Drop, but remain available in Notes mode. Drop only keeps Drop on and hides its button. No Drop keeps it off and hides its button. Both shows the button and lets you switch.
HelpHistory: Open Actions → History to see game miniatures. The current game is separate from the 10 most recent past games; pinned games do not expire. You can Pin or Unpin. Current progress resumes progress and Undo/Redo history; Initial puzzle creates another game and keeps the previous one. Your settings stay the same and the game starts paused. New games and imported links save the current game first. Games stay on this device; clearing app or browser data deletes them too.
HelpSharing: In Actions, open Share. Current progress includes numbers, notes, colors, hints, time, and errors; Initial puzzle uses only recorded clues. The link appears when the dialog opens and updates when you change the option. Each link captures that moment of the game. It includes the solution but not your settings. Recipients choose Current progress to continue or Initial puzzle to start from recorded clues, preview their choice, and confirm before replacing their game; it starts paused without undo history. In older games, recorded clues may include correctly filled numbers that were already locked. Social networks show an illustrative image, not the shared board.
HelpColors: With Drop off, select a cell and tap a color to apply it. With Drop on, choose a color and tap cells to paint. The chosen number continues guiding highlights; changing the keypad number keeps painting active. Selecting a color enables Notes; tap the active color to exit painting with Notes still on. Applying the same color again removes the mark. Clear colors removes all marks. Undo and Redo are below the colors and also restore marks. Open Actions for Auto notes, Hint, or New game. Marks are saved; a new game starts without marks.
HelpErrors: Show the error total beside the timer. Each wrong number increases it; Undo does not reduce it.
HelpNewGame: Start a new game. Difficulty comes from solving techniques: Easy (singles), Medium (locked candidates), Hard (pairs/triples), Expert (X-Wing/XY-Wing and short chains), and Master (alternating chains). The header shows the strongest technique. Older games keep their previous level.
HelpHint: Reveal the cell with the fewest candidates, clear related notes, and clear undo history. Revealed cells are yellow. Available at every level when enabled in Settings.
HelpDomino: After a correct normal or Drop entry, fill empty cells with only one candidate according to their row, column, and 3×3 box. Configure initial delay, acceleration, minimum delay, and the empty-cell limit in Settings. Limit 0 means no limit; other values allow the effect when at most that many empty cells remain. Enabled by default when at most 10 empty cells remain.
HelpSound: A correct entry plays a sound. Choose Off, Beep, or Explosion in the Sound section of Settings. Sound volume: Controls move and victory sounds. Zero mutes audio; your device volume also applies. Balloons: Number of balloons after completing a game. Zero keeps fireworks without balloons.
HelpUndo: Undo the last action. Using a hint clears undo history.
HelpRedo: Repeat the undone action. Using a hint clears undo history.
HelpAutoNotes: Automatically fill valid pencil marks in every empty cell.
HelpDark: Switch between light and dark mode.
HelpInstall: Install the app on your device as a PWA for offline use.
DropAvailabilityIntro: Drop only keeps Drop on and hides its button. No Drop keeps it off and hides its button. Both shows the button and lets you switch.
SoundVolumeIntro: Controls move and victory sounds. Zero mutes audio; your device volume also applies.
BalloonCountIntro: Number of balloons after completing a game. Zero keeps fireworks without balloons.
UpdateWaitingIntro: Accept the update in each Sudoku tab, or close the other tabs. Your game stays saved.
UpdateSaveFailed: Your game could not be saved. The update has not been applied. Try again.
